exact_verified_statement.before: Sixty-one new theorem proofs, eleven definitions and one type abbreviation make the original I573 interval atom construction explicit. With u(x)=1-smoothTransition(x-1), psi(x)=u(x)-u(2x) and phi(x)=1-u(4x)-u(4(1-x)), phi and psi are nonnegative smooth compact templates. Their closed supports lie in [1/4,3/4] and [1/2,2]. The actual left/right atoms at scale s_n=2^(-(n+2)) have closed supports strictly inside (0,1) and are exactly template compositions with inverse affine maps of slopes s_n and -s_n. For all real x and N>=0 the finite prefix equals 1-u(2^(N+2)x)-u(2^(N+2)(1-x)). At each interior point both tails vanish throughout a fixed neighborhood after one finite N. The atom sums equal the open-interval indicator pointwise and the closed-interval indicator almost everywhere. One countable index family and two fixed templates give exact nonzero slopes and affine representation. Nonnegative Tonelli proves the sum of the actual atoms' masses, and of their norm masses, is exactly one. These are one-dimensional prerequisites; no tensorization or cube Lp conclusion is inferred without proof. For every d:Nat, form alpha:Fin d->(Unit+(Nat+Nat)), a_alpha(x)=product_j a_(alpha j)(x_j), and the fixed product templates indexed by Fin d->Bool. The template index type has exactly 2^d elements. The actual atoms and templates are smooth and compactly supported; atoms are nonnegative and supported inside the coordinatewise open cube. Literal signed diagonal maps and inverses give the exact affine-template representation, with nonzero determinants. The actual atom family has sum the open-cube indicator at every point and equals the closed-cube indicator almost everywhere. Each atom is integrable and the sums of masses and norm masses are one. Complex-valued versions retain these smooth/compact/support/affine properties and exact norm identities. For every epsilon>0 the determinant weights are genuinely summable and their exact sum is (1+2*sum_(n:Nat) s_n^epsilon)^d, s_n=2^(-(n+2)); the associated ENNReal sum is strictly below top. Dimension zero and the positive-dimensional epsilon=0 obstruction are handled explicitly. No all-dimensional cube Lp conclusion is inferred from these prerequisites alone.
